description: Shepherd PR #761 to clean squash-merge: rebase off already-merged #721, fix dead stair-radius export, make Governor win-rate gate scope honest, review harness + valid 3-apple ledger
rationale: Rebase --onto origin/main to drop the 5 commits already captured by #721's squash (verified git diff 35c3397e 74b4f74d was empty), leaving only the 4 genuinely-new commits — clean, no conflicts, no #721 re-introduction. Investigated the flagged dead FLOOR2_STAIR_MARKER_RADIUS_FT export on the merits and WIRED it: hoisted to src/shared/constants.ts and consumed it as the real staircase interaction radius in MainGameScene (marker render + proximity check), plus a lockstep drift-guard test against the manifest. Made the Governor gate scope honest per rules #12/#13 — hard-gate only wired floors (Floor 1 ~98.3%), report-not-gate Floor 2's expected 0% — without weakening the Floor-1 90% gate or bending seeds. Ran the 3-apple review harness (separate-model plan review + code-review loop, both APPROVE) and recorded a valid ledger; authored ADR 0044 for the cross-layer decisions. On-estimate: no single hard sub-problem, but breadth (rebase reasoning, dead-code merits call, honesty-preserving gate fix, review harness, ADR, thread resolution, merge) squarely medium.
